_comment: SEO growth forecast for thecodefix.net. Read by scripts/seo/report.mjs and the seo-forecast skill. Scenario bands are judgement calls written down BEFORE the data arrives, so they can be checked against it; they are not model output. Never edit an old band to fit the actuals — add a revision instead.

metric.name: demand_impressions_per_week
metric.definition: totals.impressions − buckets.site.impressions for one Mon–Sun week (site: queries are owner checks, not search demand). Monthly value = mean over the weeks whose Thursday falls in that month.

drop.note: −90% in one week (2,106 → 161 impressions); position ~45. Pages stayed 'Submitted and indexed' → quality demotion, not deindexing. Concentrated in /blog troubleshooting posts.

history.at_creation: October 2026: ~45 demand impressions/week; clicks mostly brand.

assumptions: PR #143 (thin-lesson batch 2 + blog rewrites) is merged and deployed in late October 2026.
Rewritten pages are recrawled within 2–6 weeks; Google re-evaluates site quality gradually, with larger moves around core updates.
Blog troubleshooting posts (the pages that lost most) keep being rewritten in order of lost impressions.
No new thin or templated pages are published (content-guidelines §7, §37).
Optimistic needs a core update in Nov–Dec 2026 that re-scores the site; pessimistic means the site-level demotion is not re-evaluated yet.
leading_indicators: lastCrawlTime of rewritten pages moves past their rewrite date (inspections in the weekly snapshot).
Watched blog posts return to average position < 20 on their own queries.
Non-brand ('other') impressions and named queries grow week over week, before clicks do.
